steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary without creating or searching for another event.
Open the RFQ stage named by the case.
Navigate to the RFQ Responses tab where the stage Settings menu is available.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and select Withdraw to show the withdrawal dialog.

args.label: Please enter reason for withdrawing this event

steps.note: Enter the specified reason without submitting the withdrawal.
Cancel the withdrawal instead of confirming with Yes.
Verify that the withdrawal dialog closed after Cancel.
Verify the RFQ remains withdrawable, showing that Cancel did not submit the withdrawal or change the event to Withdrawn.
